craft_claim: Sustained, unmodulated maximal disclosure saturates the reader and inverts into voyeurism or misery spectacle; the intimate tone requires graduated depth and deliberate restraint.

supporting_evidence.location: Chapters on the gradual social penetration process
supporting_evidence.note: Closeness develops by graduated breadth and depth; disclosing central material before relational groundwork violates the sequence that makes penetration rewarding.

supporting_evidence.location: Chapters on the modern memoir and the 'Truth and Consequences' closing essay
supporting_evidence.note: Yagoda documents the memoir boom and its reception, including the pejorative 'misery memoir' charge that first-person trauma writing can be read as titillation and dubious authenticity.
Reference-work recognition that the term is applied pejoratively to first-person trauma narratives.

scope: Memoir, personal essay, long-form blog, and serialized first-person writing.
exceptions: Clinical or documentary registers where the reader has contracted for unsparing detail and the disclosure is not framed as intimacy.
